One agent runs Codex's native `codex review --base` command, while the other independently reviews the code against Google's "What to look for in a code review" guidance. Merge both outputs into one agreement-ranked report. Use this whenever the user asks for "review-all", a second-opinion review, a dual review, a cross-check before a PR, or a maximum-confidence review of committed branch changes. Do not use it to APPLY fixes; it is review-only.

topHot.title: gjkim-instruction
